title: REDI-NET T-2 Tick Processing
author: REDI-NET Consortium
materials: Return RINO tubes to the Bullet Blender.
Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash on the instrument.
Select program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash on the instrument.

steps.title: Sample Sorting and Storage
steps.instruction: Sort ticks into separate vials by life stage: larvae (pooled by genus), nymphs (individual), and adults (individual).

substeps.instruction: Store ticks at -20 °C for up to 2 months or -80 °C for long-term storage.
For larvae, freeze on lint roller paper at -80 °C to facilitate removal for identification.
For TNA extraction preparation, transfer 60 larvae directly into orange RINO tubes.

steps.title: Set Up Tick e-ID Device
steps.instruction: Configure the Agamotto device and log into the Tick e-ID platform.

substeps.instruction: Plug in the device and visit https://mos-id.vectech.io using Google Chrome and Bluetooth on a computer or phone.
Log in or sign up for an account.
Pair the device: Click the drop-down arrow, select 'Add New Device', click the Bluetooth icon, select 'Agamotto', and click 'Pair'.
Enter Wi-Fi credentials when prompted.
Verify device status is [Idle] in the drop-down menu.

Alternative Ethernet Setup: Select user menu (bottom right) -> 'Connect Device' -> 'Device' -> select Wi-Fi SSD -> enter password -> connect. Disconnect power and ethernet, then reconnect power until status is [Idle].

steps.title: Prepare Specimens for Multi-Imaging
steps.instruction: Organize specimens in a 96-well sample rack (8x12) while maintaining the cold chain using dry ice or cool beans.

substeps.instruction: Place a glass tray on the chill table.
Lay out samples sequentially across the row (12 per tray).
Wipe forceps with bleach wipes between samples.
Rinse RNA-later preserved samples in water and place on Kimwipes on the chiller table to absorb excess fluid.
Place 12 specimens in the tray, dorsal side up.
Close the tray lid until magnets click and insert the tray into the device slot.

steps.title: Capture Tick Images via e-ID
steps.instruction: Capture dorsal and ventral images using the Tick e-ID website.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the 'Trays' tab and click 'Capture New Tray'.
Autofill Genus/Species and Plate/Well number fields as images upload.
Remove tray, flip upside down (ventral side up), re-insert, and click 'Capture Other Side'.
Click 'Finish' and return specimens to original storage; record the tray number.

steps.title: Set Up DinoScope Imaging
steps.instruction: Prepare the DinoScope station for larval, nymph, or adult imaging.

substeps.instruction: Place a white porcelain stage (or a 5cm x 5cm paper card taped to a petri dish) on a portable chill table.
Secure the stage with tape and adjust the DinoScope holster to 4.5 cm above the stage surface.
Turn on the chill table and wait for the surface to reach -20 °C.
Wipe the stage surface with a Kimwipe and 75% ethanol.

steps.title: Capture DinoScope Images
steps.instruction: Image individual specimens using the DinoScope interface.

substeps.instruction: Place specimen dorsal side up in the center of the stage using forceps.
Adjust focus and center the specimen; ensure all key characters are visible.
Annotate file as 'Sample ID-View' (e.g., NMNH2020-D).
Enter correct magnification and ensure metadata (magnification, profile, scale, username, annotation) is visible and not overlapping the specimen.
Readjust white balance for each image to standardize background color.
Take image; if unsatisfactory, repeat focus and capture steps.
Flip specimen to ventral side and repeat imaging process.
Return specimen to tube and repeat for all samples.
Copy photos from the dated folder and save.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment for Extraction
steps.instruction: Prepare the Bullet Blender and chemical reagents for TNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool the Bullet Blender with dry ice in the cooling compartment.
Clean work surfaces with RNaseZap, then 70% molecular biology grade ethanol.
Transfer two spoons of 0.1 mm zirconium oxide beads to Clear RINO 1.5 mL screw-cap tubes.
For first-time IndiMag kit use: add 100% ethanol to Buffer AW1 and AW2, and 100% Isopropanol to ACB.
Warm Buffer ATL to 56 °C if precipitates are present. Prepare Buffer ATL-DX by adding 100 µL Reagent DX to 15 mL Buffer ATL (or 10 µL DX to 1.5 mL ATL).
Vortex MagAttract Suspension G for 3 minutes (first use) or 1 minute (subsequent uses).
Prepare 15 mL or 50 mL conical tubes with nuclease-free water for elution.

steps.title: Wash and Prepare Tick Samples
steps.instruction: Wash ticks to remove external pathogens and transfer to lysis tubes.

substeps.instruction: Clean forceps with 70% ethanol and Kimwipes.
Label navy RINO RNA lysis tubes on the cap.
Wash Adult ticks: 3 sequential washes in Petri dishes with ice-cold 1x PBS; transfer to labeled navy RINO tubes and keep on ice.

Wash Nymph ticks: 3 sequential washes in 1.5 mL tubes using 250 µL PBS (pipette off supernatant); transfer a pool of 10-15 nymphs (approx. size of one 3.2 mm bead) to labeled navy RINO tubes and keep on ice.
Wash Larval ticks: Transfer 60 ticks to a navy RINO tube. Add 200 µL 1x PBS, aspirate from the bottom using a 200 µL tip, and repeat twice. Keep on ice.

steps.title: Homogenize Tick Samples
steps.instruction: Perform dry and wet homogenization using the Bullet Blender.

substeps.instruction: Load RINO tubes with ticks into the cooled Bullet Blender.
Dry grind: Set Speed 10, Time 3. Press Start.
Remove tubes, briefly spin down, and set on ice.
Add 400 µL cold sterile 1x PBS to each tube.
Wet grind: Set Speed 10, Time 3. Press Start.
Remove tubes and inspect; repeat Speed 10, Time 3 if homogenization is incomplete.
Centrifuge at 100 x g, 4 °C for 1 minute.
Carefully transfer the top 320 µL supernatant into 1.5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Microbe Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the homogenate using beads and ATL-DX buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µL ATL-DX Lysis Buffer to 1.5 mL tubes containing 0.1 mm beads.
Transfer 320 µL homogenate to the bead tubes.
Positive Control: Transfer 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard, 100 µL EBV, 100 µL HIV standard, and 82.5 µL 1x PBS into a bead tube.
Negative Control: 320 µL cold sterile 1x PBS in a bead tube.
Load all bead tubes into the cooled Bullet Blender.
Set Speed 12, Time 3. Press Start.
Let samples settle for 1 minute, then repeat the Speed 12, Time 3 run.
Centrifuge at 120 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes.
Transfer 350 µL supernatant to a new snap-cap 1.5 mL tube. (Optional: store at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: TNA Extraction (KingFisher Flex)
steps.instruction: Extract total nucleic acids using the KingFisher Flex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Load program 'IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash'.

Set up plates: Position 1 (Sample: 985 µL lysate), Position 2 (Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer AW1), Position 3 (Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer AW2), Position 4 (Wash 3: 750 µL 80% ethanol), Position 5 (Wash 4: 750 µL 100% ethanol), Position 6 (Elution: 75 µL nuclease-free water), Position 7 (96 Deep-well Tip comb).
Add 20 µL Proteinase K to a new Deep-well plate; transfer 270 µL supernatant from lysis step into these wells.
Add 695 µL master mix (135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G) to each sample; mix by inverting or using Hula mixer for 2 min.
Start run and load plates. After ~35 mins, remove elution plate and transfer eluate to final storage.

steps.title: TNA Extraction (KingFisher Duo Prime)
steps.instruction: Extract total nucleic acids using the KingFisher Duo Prime instrument.

substeps.instruction: Load program 'IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash'.
Set up Sample Plate: Row A (Lysate/lysis buffer 985 µL), Row B (Buffer AW1 700 µL), Row C (Buffer AW2 700 µL), Row D (80% ethanol 750 µL), Row E (100% ethanol 750 µL), Row F (Tip comb 700 µL).
Set up Elution Strip: Row A (Nuclease-free water 75 µL).
Add 20 µL Proteinase K to sample row; transfer 270 µL supernatant from lysis step into these wells.
Add 695 µL master mix (135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G) to each sample; mix by inverting or using Hula mixer for 2 min.
Start run and load plate/strip. Keep the door open during extraction to prevent ethanol vapor buildup.
After ~35 mins, remove elution strip and transfer eluate to final storage.

steps.title: TNA Quantification and Storage
steps.instruction: Measure DNA and RNA concentrations using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer.

substeps.instruction: DNA Quantification: Mix 1 µL sample with 199 µL 1x HS dsDNA Qubit Assay.
RNA Quantification: Prepare working solution (199 µL Qubit RNA HS Assay buffer + 1 µL Dye). Mix 199 µL working solution with 1 µL sample and incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Store samples at -20 °C for < 2 weeks or -80 °C for long-term storage.

steps.title: Optional Pooling for Extraction
steps.instruction: Pool tick homogenates if required for a single extraction.

substeps.instruction: Combine 65 µL aliquots from five 320 µL tick homogenates into a new tube.
Preserve remaining ~255 µL of individual homogenates at -80 °C.
Record Pool ID and track individual sample IDs within the pool.
